risk: C014 residual patterns can be mistaken for validation evidence.
policy: Residual diagnostics may motivate C016 hypotheses but cannot be cited as formal accuracy validation.
paper_use: Use to justify why residual-target work is a follow-up design, not a result.
mitigation: Require a future independent official z=2 m raw_trilinear run before any validation claim.

risk: A post-hoc affine transform fitted on the official 80 probes can make R2 look positive.
policy: Post-hoc fitting on RS_caseE official targets is calibration leakage and is forbidden as validation.
paper_use: Use as a protocol-risk example in limitations.
mitigation: If calibration is studied, report it only as an upper-bound diagnostic and validate on a separate benchmark or withheld probes.

risk: The same 80 official probes define the release gate and cannot also train/tune C016.
policy: RS_caseE targets are validation data for this project, not model-fitting data.
paper_use: Use to explain why C016 must be pre-registered before the next run.
mitigation: Freeze C016 settings before running FluidX3D and record them in the native case manifest.

risk: A diagnostic residual-target hook could be misread as a default accuracy model.
policy: CityLBM must keep residual-target controls default-off until an official independent metric gate passes.
paper_use: Use to document software safeguards against overclaiming.
mitigation: Keep residT/residS default-off and block default promotion in manifests and policy gates.

risk: High-speed underprediction and downstream error can tempt direct residual correction.
policy: C016 may target range compression only through a pre-registered wall/inlet/channel-response hypothesis.
paper_use: Use to motivate the next candidate without reporting corrected metrics.
mitigation: Do not use observed residuals as per-probe correction factors in the official metric.
